#### [ ] CORESYNC-04 · Fields outside PM_TASK_FIELDS always take local's value (non-commutative, loses remote edits)  `high` `data-loss` `effort M`
- **Where:** `packages/core/src/reconciliation/plan-reconciler.ts:231`
- **Problem:** The merge builds `{...base, ...remote, ...local}` and then re-resolves only `PM_TASK_FIELDS`. baseline, teamId, description, fields, minGapDays, calendar, calendarId and custom keys therefore always come from local, and a collaborator's change to any of them is lost whenever the local user touched another field of the same task. merge(A,B) ≠ merge(B,A).
- **Fix:**
  - `mergeFields(base, local, remote, skip, localClock, remoteClock)` iterates `keys(base) ∪ keys(local) ∪ keys(remote)`, minus `ENTITY_SKIP_KEYS` (`id` plus RECORD_SYNC_KEYS).
  - It applies `decideValue` to each key and merges `fieldTimestamps` per key with `laterStamp`.
  - `updatedAt`/`updatedBy` come from the later record clock.
  - `PM_TASK_FIELDS` stays exported for docs and audit only; the merge no longer uses it.
- **Verify:** `reconciler.test.ts`: remote edits `baseline`, `description`, `fields.risk` and a custom key `x` while local edits `label`. All edits are kept, and both argument orders produce the same hash.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-05 · Meta, documents, calendars, people, teams and categories merge without 3-way logic  `high` `data-loss` `effort L`
- **Where:** `packages/core/src/reconciliation/plan-reconciler.ts:559`, `packages/core/src/reconciliation/plan-reconciler.ts:624`
- **Problem:** Documents, calendars and other root keys come from remote. Every meta field except title comes from local, and title comes from remote. People and teams are unions where remote wins on id clashes, and categories are `{...local, ...remote}`. As a result, local additions are lost, remote scale, dates and baselines are lost, renames are reverted, and deleted people, teams or categories come back.
- **Fix:**
  - `meta`: `mergeFields(base.meta, local.meta, remote.meta, META_SYNC_KEYS, planClocks)`, then stamp revision, updatedAt, sync, tombstones and contentHash fresh.
  - `people`, `teams` and `documents` (id lists) and `categories`, `calendars` (maps) go through `mergeKeyedEntries`, per id against the base:
    - Added on one side: keep.
    - Removed on one side, unchanged on the other: remove.
    - Removed on one side, edited on the other: keep, and record a `meta` conflict.
    - Present on both sides: `mergeFields`.
  - Any other root key, including unknown ones, goes through `decideValue` on the whole value.
  - A 2-way merge (no base) cannot detect removals, so it keeps the union. Document this in JSDoc. These entities get no tombstones, because rooms always have a base once CORESYNC-19 lands.
  - Output order is deterministic (base order, then additions sorted by id), so the hash does not depend on which side is local.
- **Verify:** `reconciler.test.ts`: local renames a person, adds a category and renames the title; remote changes `meta.scale`, deletes a team that local left untouched, and adds a document. The merge keeps all of these and removes the team.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-07 · One-sided tasks ignore existing tombstones (2-way/stale-base merges resurrect deletes)  `medium` `bug` `effort S`

- **Problem:** In Scenarios 2/3, a task that is absent from the base is pushed as active without checking `tombstoneMap`. The merged plan then holds both the task and its tombstone, dependencies on the task are pruned, and the next merge's Case 1D drops it again, so the plan flip-flops. Every `mergePlansCommutative` call (base=null) hits this.
- **Fix:**
  - In `mergeRecordList`, when a record exists on one side only and `tombstoneFor(state, id, kind)` finds a tombstone:

  - Apply the same rule to notes.
  - A final sweep enforces the invariant that no live record keeps a tombstone.
- **Verify:** `reconciler.test.ts`: remote hard-deleted t1 with a meta tombstone at T2, and a stale local copy of t1 was edited at T1 (base null). t1 is gone and the tombstone stays. With the local edit at T3 instead, t1 is kept and the tombstone is removed. Repeat both cases for notes.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-08 · Dependency pruning strips object-form deps in arrays and misses lag/';' syntax  `medium` `bug` `effort S`
- **Where:** `packages/core/src/reconciliation/plan-reconciler.ts:539`
- **Problem:** Array deps are filtered with `typeof depId === "string"`, so every full merge removes all object-form deps. String deps are split only on `,`, so `"t1:SS+2d"` or `"a;b"` pointing at a deleted task are never pruned and stay dangling.
- **Fix:**
  - `pruneDeletedDependencies(tasks, tombstones)` calls `filterDependsOn(task.dependsOn, rel => !deletedIds.has(rel.id), knownIds)` from `dependencies.ts`, which keeps each item's original shape and returns the original value when nothing is removed.
  - `deletedIds` is the set of task tombstones that have no live task.
  - Skip the pass entirely when that set is empty.
- **Verify:** `reconciler.test.ts`, with task b deleted:
  - `[{id:"a",type:"SS"}, "b:FS+2d"]` becomes `{id:"a",type:"SS"}`.
  - `"a;b"` becomes `"a"`.
  - `{id:"b"}` becomes `null`.
  - With no deletion, the value is returned unchanged (`toBe`).

#### [ ] CORESYNC-11 · Tombstones capped at 50 and timestamped at merge time, so stale peers resurrect deletions  `medium` `data-loss` `effort M`
- **Where:** `packages/core/src/reconciliation/plan-reconciler.ts:590`, `packages/core/src/reconciliation/plan-reconciler.ts:385`, `packages/core/src/reconciliation/plan-reconciler.ts:438`
- **Problem:** The hard-coded `MAX_TOMBSTONES = 50` evicts older tombstones whenever many tasks are deleted at once (for example clearing a template), and stale peers then re-add those tasks. Hard deletes get synthetic `${nowIso}` deletion times, so peers store different times for one deletion and edit-after-delete ordering breaks.
- **Fix:**
  - Add `ReconcileOptions.maxTombstones` (default 1000) next to `tombstoneMaxAgeDays` (30). One `pruneTombstones(map, cutoffMs, max)` keeps the newest.
  - Deletion time precedence:
    1. an existing tombstone's time;
    2. the record's `deletedAt`;
    3. the record's `updatedAt`;
    4. one `fallbackDeletedAt` (`now#clientId`) per merge call.
  - Hard-delete detection (present in base, missing on one side) reuses an existing tombstone, and Scenario 4 never re-stamps.
  - Callers write `meta.tombstones[id] = {deletedAt: "<ISO>#<client>", entityType}` at delete time: hand-off to `pgstate` (PGSTATE-14) and `coreinteract` (ARCH-04).
- **Verify:** `reconciler.test.ts`:
  - Deleting 120 tasks and then merging with a stale peer that still holds all of them resurrects none.
  - A pre-existing tombstone keeps the same `deletedAt` across two merges run at different fake times.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-22 · ETag optimistic concurrency never engages because X-Firebase-ETag is not requested  `medium` `bug` `effort S`
- **Where:** `packages/core/src/firebase-sync.ts:285`, `packages/core/src/firebase-sync.ts:385`, `packages/core/tests/firebase-sync.test.ts:88`
- **Problem:** Firebase REST returns an ETag only when the request sends `X-Firebase-ETag: true`, which no call sends. The etag is therefore always null, `if-match` is never sent and concurrent saves blindly overwrite each other. The tests mock an ETag the real service would not return.
- **Fix:**
  - `firebaseRequest` always sends `X-Firebase-ETag: true`.
  - `saveCloudRoom` fails closed: without `options.etag` it GETs first to obtain one, then PUTs with `if-match`.
  - A 412 response refetches and returns `{conflict: true, latestRemoteData, etag}`, with the data decoded.
- **Verify:** `firebase-sync.test.ts` asserts the request headers (`X-Firebase-ETag` on GET and PUT, `if-match` on PUT) and the GET-before-PUT when no etag is given.

- **Where:** `packages/core/src/firebase-sync.ts:129`, `packages/core/src/firebase-sync.ts:181`

  - Codec escapes:
    - a literal `__schema` key ↔ `~u_schema`;
    - `""` ↔ `~e`;
    - ASCII control characters ↔ `~xhh`;

- **Verify:** `firebase-sync.test.ts`:

  - The RTDB-normalization cases in `rtdb-codec.test.ts` belong to `rules` (RULES-27).

#### [ ] CORESYNC-37 · Remote fetch silently falls back to a hard-coded personal proxy  `medium` `security` `effort S`
- **Where:** `packages/core/src/remote-sync.ts:126`, `packages/core/src/remote-sync.ts:147`
- **Problem:** `fetchWithCorsFallback` sends the URL to `DEFAULT_WORKER_URL` whenever the direct fetch throws or returns any non-OK status (401/403/404/500), with no opt-in. Token-bearing URLs leak to a third-party worker, and every failure costs a second request.
- **Fix:**
  - Remove `DEFAULT_WORKER_URL`.
  - Extend the options additively: `fetchRemotePlan(url, {previousHash, proxyUrl, signal, timeoutMs, maxBytes})`.
  - Use a proxy only on explicit opt-in: a per-call `proxyUrl`, or a page-wide `window.__JANTT_CORS_PROXY` that the host app sets. Nothing in the repo sets that global today.
  - Even with a proxy configured, use it only when the direct fetch threw a `TypeError` (CORS or network), never on an HTTP status.
  - Never proxy URLs that carry userinfo or token-like params (`token`, `access_token`, `auth`, `key`, `sig`, `rlkey`); throw a clear error instead.
- **Verify:** `remote-sync.test.ts`:
  - Direct 404: error, fetch called once.
  - TypeError and no `proxyUrl`: network error, fetch called once.
  - TypeError with `proxyUrl`: the proxy is called.
  - A `?token=` URL with `proxyUrl`: no proxy call.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-39 · Worker is an open proxy (SSRF) with no origin or host enforcement  `medium` `security` `effort M`
- **Where:** `worker/src/worker.js:190`, `worker/src/worker.js:236`, `worker/README.md:75`
- **Problem:** The worker fetches any `?url=` with `redirect: "follow"`. The Origin header only picks which ACAO value to echo, so requests are never rejected, even though the README claims "origin-locked". Anyone can use it as an anonymizing proxy and burn the 100K/day quota.
- **Fix:**
  - Return 403 JSON when `Origin` is missing or not allowlisted (dev origins per CORESYNC-46).
  - `validateTarget(raw)` parses with `new URL` and requires:
    - `https:`, the default port and no userinfo;
    - a hostname under one of the allowlisted suffixes: `githubusercontent.com`, `dropbox.com`, `dropboxusercontent.com`, plus any comma-separated `env.EXTRA_ALLOWED_HOSTS`;
    - not the worker's own host.
  - Anything else gets 400.
  - Use `redirect: "manual"` and follow at most 3 hops, re-validating each `Location`. Upstream timeout is 10 s.
  - When an `env.RATE_LIMITER` binding exists, call `limit({key: CF-Connecting-IP})` (60/min) and return 429 on refusal. Ship it commented out as a `[[ratelimits]]` block in wrangler.toml, because it needs a wrangler version with Workers Rate Limiting support. The code skips the check without it.
  - Rewrite the README "Security" section to match.
- **Verify:** `worker/tests/worker.test.js`:
  - No Origin, or an evil Origin: 403.
  - `http://…`, `https://evil.example`, `https://raw.githubusercontent.com.evil.io` and `https://127.0.0.1`: 400.
  - An allowlisted URL that redirects to an evil host: 400, with upstream fetched exactly once.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-41 · Worker memory is unbounded: the cache never evicts and bodies are unlimited  `medium` `performance` `effort M`
- **Where:** `worker/src/worker.js:39`, `worker/src/worker.js:251`, `worker/src/worker.js:116`
- **Problem:** `cloudResponseCache` grows forever and is keyed by the raw URL string, so `?x=1`, `?x=2` and so on each add an entry. `response.text()` and `request.json()` read bodies of any size. Together these can exhaust the 128 MB isolate.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-42 · Quota shield serves revoked content indefinitely and mislabels 403 as a rate limit  `medium` `security` `effort S`
- **Where:** `worker/src/worker.js:256`, `worker/src/worker.js:269`, `packages/core/src/remote-sync.ts:194`
- **Problem:** A 403 is treated like a 429. If the file was cached, the cached copy (of any age) is served as 200, so a file made private keeps being served. Without a cache, the 403 becomes a 429 "rate limit", and the client shows "pacing requests" instead of "access denied".
- **Fix:**
  - Serve stale content only on 429, 503 or a network error, and only within `STALE_MAX_MS` (60 s past the TTL).
  - Pass 401/403/404/410 through unchanged and delete the cache entry.
  - Do not cache responses whose `Cache-Control` contains `no-store` or `private`.
  - The remote-sync error mapping stays status-faithful.
- **Verify:** `worker.test.js` with fake timers:
  - Cached, then upstream 403: the client gets 403 and the next request re-fetches.
  - Cached plus a 429 at TTL+30 s: 200 stale with `X-Jantt-Quota-Shield`.
  - At TTL+90 s: 429.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-14 · Timestamp ordering is string- and locale-based with no clock-skew protection  `low` `bug` `effort M`

  - `9999-12-31…` sorts below a current stamp.
  - `#b` sorts above `#a` regardless of locale.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-16 · Plan hash is key-order dependent and weaker than its docstring claims  `low` `inconsistency` `effort S`

  - `reconciler.test.ts`: for a plan with tombstones where local equals base, the result is the remote plan by identity (fast path taken).

- **Verify:** `firebase-sync.test.ts` with a fake EventSource:
  - A put at `/`, then a put at `/data/tasks/0/label`, then a patch at `/data` each produce a full, valid payload with the new label.

#### [ ] CORESYNC-48 · Room id and slug helpers are duplicated and inconsistent  `low` `inconsistency` `effort S`

- **Problem:** `generateRoomSlug` emits `room_…`, but `sanitizeRoomId` rewrites `_` to `-`, so a sanitized generated id points to a different RTDB node and joins silently 404. `generateRoomId` and `generateRoomSlug` overlap, and roomService used a 40-bit slug as a secret.
- **Fix:**
  - One private `randomHex(bytes)` that requires `crypto.getRandomValues` (available in all supported runtimes) and removes the `Math.random` fallback.
  - `generateRoomId` (`-` separator) and `generateRoomSlug` (`_` separator, which existing rooms use) both delegate to it.
  - `sanitizeRoomId`:
    1. lowercase;
    2. `[^a-z0-9_-]` becomes `-`;
    3. collapse separator runs with `/([-_])[-_]+/g → "$1"`;
    4. trim leading and trailing separators;
    5. clip to 64.
    - The result is idempotent on both generators and matches the app's `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{2,63}$`.
  - Secrets come only from `generateSecureToken` (128-bit). roomService's secret is fixed by `fbsvc` (FBSVC-03 / ARCH-25).
- **Verify:** `firebase-sync.test.ts`:
  - `sanitizeRoomId(generateRoomSlug())` and `sanitizeRoomId(generateRoomId())` return their input unchanged.
  - Update the expectation `"TEAM_Alpha__Sprint"` to `"team_alpha_sprint"`.

### Tasks (severity order)

#### [ ] PGSTATE-01 · Undo history survives project switches, so Ctrl+Z writes the previous plan's data into the current one  `high` `data-loss` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/hooks/useUndoRedo.ts:61`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useProjectState.ts:93`, `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:138`
- **Problem:** `clearHistory` (useUndoRedo.ts:61-64) is never called. Selecting, creating, importing, forking or opening a room keeps `past` intact. `undo()` then runs `editor.handleChartCommit(snapshotOfPlanA)` while plan B is active, and the commit re-stamps A's content, autosaves it into B and pushes it to B's room.
- **Fix:**
  - Have `useUndoRedo` subscribe to `commandBus` `ACTIVE_PROJECT_CHANGED` (`useProjectState` emits it on every path) and reset `past`/`future` there.
  - Stamp each history entry with `projectId`. `undo()`/`redo()` drop the stack and do nothing when `entry.projectId !== activeProjectIdRef.current` (defence in depth for any path that skips the event).
  - New signature: `useUndoRedo({ activeProjectId, getCurrent, applyData, readOnly, onReadOnly, showToast })`. `getCurrent` reads `parsedDataRef`, so `undo`/`redo` stay stable callbacks and the App keydown effect stops re-binding on every render. App wiring is done by `pgshell`.
- **Verify:** `hooks/useUndoRedo.test.ts`: record a commit on project A, emit `ACTIVE_PROJECT_CHANGED` to B, and assert `undo()` never calls `applyData` and `canUndo === false`. Then run manual check 4a.

#### [ ] PGSTATE-02 · Undo is replayed as a fresh local edit, which overwrites collaborators and fails for multi-task changes  `high` `false-logic` `effort L`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:140`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useEditorState.ts:153`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useEditorState.ts:80`
- **Problem:** Undo entries are whole-plan deep copies (up to 31 per stack) taken before any remote merges. They are re-applied through `handleChartCommit`, which stamps every differing field with a new `${now}#${peer}`. In a room, Ctrl+Z therefore reverts collaborators' fields, and the fresh stamps make the stale values win LWW. Undoing a multi-task add does nothing, because the deletion guard restores the tasks being undone.
- **Fix:**
  - Record history from `LOCAL_COMMIT` (`{ before, after, origin }`; add `origin: "chart" | "editor" | "undo" | "redo" | "reset" | "restore"` to the event). Skip `undo`/`redo` origins. Delete `pushSnapshot` and the App call in `handleGanttCommit` (pgshell).
  - Add pure exported `diffPlan(before, after): PlanPatch`. Tasks: `changed[{ id, fields: { f: [old, new] } }]` over core `PM_TASK_FIELDS` plus `_deleted`, `added: Task[]`, `removed: { task, index }[]`. Plan: `[old, new]` for `people`, `teams`, `notes`, `categories`, `milestones`, `documents`, `calendars` and whitelisted `meta` keys (`title`, `scale`, `defaultGapDays`, `showBaselines`, `showCriticalPath`). Values are compared with the existing `sameValue`. An empty patch is not pushed, which replaces the `.tasks`-only `JSON.stringify` dedupe.
  - Add pure `applyPlanPatch(current, patch, "undo" | "redo"): { data, skipped }`. A field reverts only while its current value still equals the patch's target; otherwise it is skipped, because a collaborator changed it. `added` ids are removed through `deleteTasks()` (tombstoned). `removed` tasks are re-inserted at their index if absent, and their tombstone is cleared.
  - Apply through `handleChartCommit(next, { origin: "undo" })`. Stamping then touches only the reverted fields, and the commit is authoritative with no heuristic (see PGSTATE-03).
  - Coalesce consecutive `origin: "editor"` entries within 1000 ms into one entry. Cap the stack at 100 entries. Memory becomes O(changed fields) instead of 31 full plans.
  - When `skipped > 0`, toast: `Undid change (N fields kept: edited by a collaborator)`.
- **Verify:** Unit tests in `hooks/useUndoRedo.test.ts` cover `diffPlan`/`applyPlanPatch`: (a) a remote edit to another field of the same task survives undo; (b) undo of a 5-task add removes all 5 and writes tombstones; (c) redo restores them; (d) a field changed since the commit is skipped and counted. Manual: two browsers in one room, A drags a bar while B renames it, then A presses Ctrl+Z: the bar moves back and B's rename stays.

#### [ ] PGSTATE-03 · Deletion guard in handleChartCommit drops legitimate commits that remove or replace 2+ tasks  `high` `bug` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/hooks/useEditorState.ts:80`, `apps/playground/src/components/views/CanvasView.tsx:325`
- **Problem:** Any commit with 2 or more fewer tasks is mapped over the master list, so new ids are dropped and removed tasks come back. The Canvas generator, bulk deletes, undo of multi-adds, and imports with 3 or more `_deleted` tombstones all silently fail while the UI reports success. The in-progress `mergeCommittedTasks` unions ids but keeps the `silentlyMissing <= 1` heuristic, so a replacement now appends instead of failing.
- **Fix:**
  - Replace the heuristic with explicit semantics: `handleChartCommit(data, { partial?: boolean, origin? })`. By default `data.tasks` is authoritative. With `partial: true`, omitted tasks are left untouched (union by id, new ids kept, removals only through tombstones).
  - Authoritative commits record `meta.tombstones[id] = { deletedAt, entityType: "task" }` for every live master id that disappeared. Tombstoning then happens in one place, so the core Delete key, Canvas replace, sidebar delete and undo all propagate to rooms.
  - Audited callers: Kanban, Tasks, Notes, People, Add Task and the sidebar all pass the full list. Filtered subsets arrive only through App `handleGanttCommit`, which (pgshell) drops its manual map-over-master merge and passes `{ partial: isHideActive || isPersonSorting }`.
  - Keep the logic in an exported pure `resolveCommittedTasks(master, updated, { partial, deletedAt })` so it can be unit tested.
- **Verify:** `hooks/useEditorState.test.ts`: (a) an authoritative commit with 3 fewer tasks removes them and adds 3 tombstones; (b) a partial subset keeps the omitted tasks and adds new ids; (c) a generator-style full replacement yields exactly the new list. Manual: Canvas benchmark generator with fewer tasks than exist.

#### [ ] PGSTATE-04 · Creating, duplicating, importing or copying a plan switches projects without flushing the pending autosave  `high` `data-loss` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/hooks/useProjectState.ts:238`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useProjectState.ts:433`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useProjectState.ts:519`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts:148`
- **Problem:** Only `handleSelectProject` and `handleDeleteProject` flush. The other paths call `setActiveProjectId` directly. The autosave effect cleanup then cancels the timer, and the next save targets the new id, so edits made in the 5-60 s window before New/Duplicate/Import/Local Copy are lost. `handleDuplicateProject` also copies `found.data` (the last saved state), so the duplicate misses those edits too.
- **Fix:**
  - Route every create, copy, import, fork and duplicate path through `addAndOpenProject` → `activateProject`. `activateProject` calls `flushPendingSaveRef.current?.()` before any ref or state changes, then sets refs, the URL and editor state, and emits `ACTIVE_PROJECT_CHANGED`. This is partly in progress already.
  - Export `activateProject`/`addAndOpenProject` for the App paths (`handleForkToLocalCopy`, `handleSelectCloudRoom`, hash import; pgshell). Remove `setActiveProjectId` from the hook's return once they migrate, so no path can bypass the flush.
  - `handleDuplicateProject`: when `projectId === activeProjectIdRef.current`, copy `parsedDataRef.current` (live data), not `found.data`.
  - Use functional list updates via `commitProjects(mutate)` everywhere, so a stale `customProjects` closure can never drop entries. This also closes the useProjectState side of PGMODALS-02/03.
- **Verify:** Manual: edit a plan, click New Plan within 5 s, reopen the original: the edit is present. Same for Duplicate: the copy contains the unsaved edit.

#### [ ] PGSTATE-05 · Multiple tabs overwrite each other's whole project list; cross-tab sync is a no-op because all tabs share one peer id  `high` `data-loss` `effort M`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/utils.ts:109`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useProjectState.ts:601`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useEditorState.ts:103`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useDynamicSync.ts:75`
- **Problem:** `saveProjectData` writes the tab's own in-memory `SavedProject[]`, so tab B's autosave erases plans created or edited in tab A. No `storage` listener exists. BroadcastChannel `senderId` is the shared `jantt_peer_id`, so every tab drops every sibling message as its own echo.
- **Fix:**
  - All list writes go through `commitProjects(mutate)` → `updateStoredProjects` (read-modify-write from storage, then `setCustomProjects(next)`). `saveProjectData` replaces only its own entry by id, spreading the stored entry so foreign fields (for example roomsync's future `syncedData`) survive. Do not call `saveCustomProjects` inside a `setState` updater. Return the write's boolean.
  - In `useProjectState`, add a `window` `storage` listener for `STORAGE_KEYS.CUSTOM_PROJECTS`: `setCustomProjects(loadSavedProjects())`, but keep this tab's active entry from memory (the editor is its source of truth).
  - Add `getTabId()` to `utils.ts`: a `crypto.randomUUID()` held in module memory and never persisted. roomsync's `useDynamicSync` uses it as `senderId`. `getPeerId()` stays the per-browser LWW author id.
  - Echo guard (ARCH-09): `executeSave` is a no-op when `parsedDataRef.current === lastSavedDataRef.current` (identity, O(1)). roomsync's `broadcastLocalChange` drops payloads whose `meta.contentHash` equals the last applied inbound hash.
  - Performance: read-modify-write costs one parse of the list per save (milliseconds at MB size, at most once per debounce). Splitting storage per plan is deferred unless profiling shows a need.
- **Verify:** `utils.test.ts`: seed storage with an entry "from another tab", run the `saveProjectData` mutation, and assert both entries persist. Then run manual check 4b, plus live sync of an edit between two tabs on the same plan.

#### [ ] PGSTATE-06 · localStorage quota and write failures are swallowed, and autosave still reports 'Saved'  `high` `error-handling` `effort M`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/services/storage/local-storage-service.ts:69`, `apps/playground/src/utils.ts:109`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts:60`
- **Problem:** On quota failure, `setItem` writes to an in-memory Map and `saveCustomProjects` adds another empty catch. `executeSave` then sets `saved` unconditionally and `Save Now` toasts success. Every later edit, and room secrets in `room-storage.ts`, is lost on reload while the UI says "Saved just now".
- **Fix:**
  - `IStorageService.setItem(): boolean` (in progress). Propagate it through `saveCustomProjects` → `updateStoredProjects` → `commitProjects`/`saveProjectData` and the default-plan write.
  - `useAutoSave`: `saveStatus: "saved" | "saving" | "pending" | "error"` plus `saveError: string | null`. On failure, keep `lastSavedAt` and toast only on the transition into `error`. `handleManualSaveNow` toasts success only when the write succeeded. `beforeunload` calls `preventDefault()` only while the status is `error`.
  - Export `freeUpStorage()` from `useSnapshotVault`, which migrates or prunes snapshot keys (PGSTATE-08) and retries the save. `AutoSaveModal` (pgmodals, PGMODALS-37) renders "Storage full — changes are NOT saved" with Free space and Export JSON.
  - ARCH-30: route the remaining raw `localStorage` calls in the owned hooks through `storageService`: autosave interval, `beforeunload`, Kanban sort, person filter, active id and the vault. Add any missing keys to `STORAGE_KEYS`.
  - pgshell widens the `saveStatus` prop type in `Navbar`, `MobileNavbar` and `MobileActionMenuSheet`.
- **Verify:** `storage.test.ts`: stub `Storage.prototype.setItem` to throw `new DOMException("", "QuotaExceededError")`, then assert `setItem` returns `false` and `getItem` returns the newer value. Then run manual check 4c.

#### [ ] PGSTATE-10 · Share-link (#data=) import re-runs on every reload and overwrites the edited copy or unrelated plans with the same name  `high` `data-loss` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/utils.ts:336`, `apps/playground/src/utils.ts:369`, `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:646`
- **Problem:** `#data=` is never stripped. On reload, `loadInitialState` re-imports it and replaces any non-linked plan with the same name and task count with the original payload. The hashchange handler drops every plan with the same name, and that name comes from the attacker-controllable `?name=`.
- **Fix:**

- **Verify:** `utils.test.ts`: importing the same payload twice gives 1 entry and keeps its edited data, and a pre-existing local plan with the same name is untouched. Then run manual check 4d.

#### [ ] PGSTATE-08 · Snapshot vault fills the storage quota and deletes other projects' history, contradicting 'Zero-Data-Loss'  `medium` `architecture` `effort L`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/hooks/useSnapshotVault.ts:13`, `apps/playground/src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts:66`, `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:295`
- **Problem:** Every autosave stores a full deep copy, 30 per project, in localStorage. At a 5 s cadence that covers a few minutes and exhausts the ~5 MB quota that plan data needs. On quota failure, `safeSaveSnapshots` silently deletes another project's entire history.
- **Fix:**
  - New `services/storage/snapshot-store.ts`: a minimal IndexedDB wrapper of about 60 lines with no dependency (db `jantt`, store `snapshots`, keyPath `id`, index `projectId`). Methods: `list`, `put`, `deleteMany`, `deleteProject`. When IndexedDB is unavailable, it falls back to memory and reports `persistent: false`, which VersionHistory shows as "kept for this session only".
  - Capture policy: autosave captures at most once per 2 minutes per project. Explicit reasons always capture: `Before restore`, `Before reset`, `Before room overwrite`. Retention uses pure `selectSnapshotsToKeep(entries, now)`: everything from the last 2 hours (at most 20), one per hour for 24 hours, one per day for 30 days, at most 60 per project. It never touches other projects.
  - One-time idle migration: move the `jantt_snapshots_*` localStorage keys into IndexedDB, then remove them. This frees quota for plans.
  - Provide module-level `captureSnapshot(projectId, data, reason)` plus a subscribe, so `useProjectState` and App can capture without depending on hook order. The hook keeps `{ snapshots, captureSnapshot, clearSnapshots }`, now loaded asynchronously. Run captures off the hot path with `setTimeout(0)`, using structured clone (no `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify())`).
  - Stop writing `ACTIVE_JSON` (the in-progress `DEFAULT_PLAN` key replaces it). pgshell renames the App comment and label to "Version history".
- **Verify:** `hooks/useSnapshotVault.test.ts` checks the retention buckets of `selectSnapshotsToKeep`. Manual: after load, DevTools > Application shows no `jantt_snapshots_*` in localStorage. After 30 minutes of edits, history spans the whole session.

The verifier classed the "3 lists + drag and drop" part as a feature gap, owned by pgmodals-a (owner ask #2).
- **Fix:**

#### [ ] PGSTATE-31 · Reset button discards edits with no confirmation or undo, and desyncs editor and chart on invalid data  `low` `ux` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/hooks/useProjectState.ts:567`, `apps/playground/src/components/layout/EditorPane.tsx:267`
- **Problem:** `handleResetActiveProject` replaces the editor text immediately. There is no confirm and no backup, and when the stored copy is invalid it updates the text but leaves the old `parsedData`. For rooms, it resets to the local cache and then pushes that as a local edit.
- **Fix:**
  - Capture `"Before reset"` (module `captureSnapshot`) and emit `LOCAL_COMMIT` with `origin: "reset"` (already emitted in progress), so Ctrl+Z reverts it.

- **Verify:** Manual: edit, click Reset, confirm, press Ctrl+Z: the edits are back. With a corrupt stored entry, Reset shows the toast and the chart is unchanged.

#### [ ] PGSTATE-38 · Share payload decompression has no size cap (zip bomb via #data=), and the link reloads into a crash loop  `low` `url-hardening` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/utils.ts:124`, `packages/core/src/share-coder.ts:145`

## WS-06 · Playground shell: App, layout, navigation, common components  (`pgshell`)

- **Goal:** Make the shell safe and honest: no script injection, no App-level path that loses or overwrites plans, one chrome row with a Cloud popover in place of the subheader, one z-index scale, and keyboard, screen-reader and responsive behaviour that works, without adding render work to the typing, drag or idle paths.

- **Contracts:**
  - **Owner ask #3 (from the plan JSON):** remove the cloud subheader strip from the layout. Add a `Cloud` button in Navbar, plus an entry in the mobile action menu, that toggles an anchored popover (click-outside and Escape close it, focus is managed, `aria-expanded` is set). The popover renders `<CloudBar …/>` with the exact props CloudBar declares today. roomsync makes CloudBar compact panel content.
  - **Owner ask #1:** the fix lives mainly in `packages/core/src/theme.css` (corerender). This workstream fixes any App-level CSS in `index.css` that contributes to the critical-path layer painting over the sticky header.
  - **Error boundary:** add a top-level React ErrorBoundary in the new file `apps/playground/src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.tsx`.
  - **Interfaces this workstream publishes (others code against these):**
    - z-index tokens on `:root` in `index.css`: `--z-chrome:100`, `--z-popover:200`, `--z-editor-overlay:900`, `--z-drawer:1000` (equal to the core drawer literal), `--z-modal:1100`, `--z-modal-raised:1200`, `--z-palette:1300`, `--z-toast:1400`, and `--mobile-nav-h`. pgmodals-a/b, fbsvc and roomsync use `var(--z-modal)` / `var(--z-modal-raised)` in place of inline `9999`/`10000`.
    - Responsive modal base classes in `index.css`: `.prompt-modal-backdrop`, `.prompt-modal-card`, `.settings-modal-card` and `.modal-content`. They are centered on desktop and become a bottom sheet at 768px and below. pgmodals-a's ModalHost keeps these class names, or tells this workstream the single class it uses.
    - `SHORTCUTS: { id, keys: string[], description, category }[]` and `MOD_KEY` exported from `hooks/useGlobalShortcuts.ts`. ShortcutsModal (pgmodals-b) renders this list and has no list of its own.
    - The `handleGanttCommit` prop of ViewRouter becomes the guarded `commitPlan` (viewer and pending-login gate, `partial` flag). pgviews routes Kanban, Tasks and Notes through it (PGVIEWS-05).
    - `EmptyChartState` gains optional props `onOpenEditor` and `onRestoreLastValid`. pgviews passes them from ViewRouter.
    - `export type GanttViewport = ReturnType<typeof useGanttViewport>` and `DateFilterState`, so pgviews can type ViewRouterProps.
    - `export-actions.ts`: `exportMsProject`, `exportPrimavera` and `exportReport`, which load `@jantt/interop` lazily, filter out `_deleted` tasks and toast on failure. pgmodals-a may reuse them in ShareModal.
  - **Interfaces consumed (owned elsewhere):**
    - pgstate: `project.activateProject`, `addAndOpenProject` and `commitProjects`; `importSharedPlan`, `readSharePayloadFromUrl`/`stripSharePayloadFromUrl`, `setPlanUrl` and `downloadTextFile` from `utils.ts`; `init.savedProjects`; `handleChartCommit(data, { partial, origin })`; `useUndoRedo({ activeProjectId, getCurrent, applyData, readOnly, onReadOnly, showToast })` with `canUndo`/`canRedo`; `useSaveStatusLabel`; `saveStatus` including `"error"`; `useModalSlot`/`ModalProvider`; `latestSnapshot`; `purgeProjectStorage`.
    - roomsync: CloudBar props, plus `roomSync.syncStatus`, `syncMessage`, `isProcessing` and `setShowRoomModal`.
    - fbsvc: `auth.isLoadingAuth`, `isSigningIn`, `lastAuthError`, `isGateSatisfied` and `requireGitHubGate`.
    - coresync: a bounded share decoder that returns null on oversize input.
    - pgmodals-a: the leaf `Modal` primitive (Escape, focus trap and return, scroll lock).
    - Every consumed prop or option is optional with today's behaviour as fallback, so any merge order compiles.
- **Exit criteria:**
  1. `npm run build -w @jantt/playground` and `npx tsc -p apps/playground --noEmit` pass, with no new `any` in the owned files.
  2. `npm test -w @jantt/playground` passes the shell tests: `hooks/useGlobalShortcuts.test.ts`, `components/common/CommandPalette.test.tsx`, `components/common/Popover.test.tsx`, `components/common/ErrorBoundary.test.tsx`, `hooks/useToast.test.ts`, `hooks/useDateFilter.test.ts`, `hooks/useMobileDetection.test.ts` and `export-actions.test.ts`.
  3. Grep gates:
     - No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `window.confirm` or `alert(` in the owned files.
     - No `Subheader` reference under `apps/playground/src`.
     - Every `z-index` in `index.css` and the owned TSX is a `var(--z-*)` token or a local value of 60 or less.
  4. Owner asks, checked by hand at 1280px, 1440px and 375×812:
     - #3: one chrome row above the DateFilterBar. The Cloud popover opens on click and closes on Escape (focus returns to the button), on outside click and when Tab leaves it. `aria-expanded` follows. The mobile sheet's Cloud entry shows the same CloudBar.
     - #1, together with corerender's change: with critical path on, no bar, glow, lasso box or Settings popover paints over the day/month header in any theme.
     - #4, shell part: no dialog or task-sheet footer sits under the bottom nav, and toasts stay readable above modals.
  5. Data-safety script, checked by hand:
     - (a) A share link named like an existing plan leaves both plans in place, and Back/Forward imports nothing.
     - (b) An edit followed within the autosave window by opening a room or a share link is kept.
     - (c) Ctrl+Z after switching plans changes nothing. A viewer's Ctrl+Z opens the fork prompt.
     - (d) Ctrl+C on selected text copies and does not toggle the critical path.
  6. Production checks:
     - `vite preview` of a production build: GitHub sign-in, room join, exports and the canvas view raise zero CSP violations.
     - React Profiler: 10 s idle records 0 `App` commits, and one splitter drag records 1 `App` commit.

### Tasks (severity order)

#### [ ] PGSHELL-01 · Stored XSS: Command palette renders task id/start/end as raw HTML  `critical` `security` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/components/common/CommandPalette.tsx:393`, `:635`; `packages/core/src/validator.ts:62` (coresched)
- **Problem:** The task subtitle interpolates raw `task.id`, `start` and `end` next to `&bull;`/`&rarr;` entities and renders the result with `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. The validator accepts any non-empty id. A `#data=` link, a room or an import with the id `<img src=x onerror=…>` therefore runs script in the app origin as soon as the victim types a matching query, which exposes the Firebase session and every room the victim owns.
- **Fix:**
  - Build `subtitle` as a plain string with literal `•` and `→` and render `{cmd.subtitle}` as a text child. Delete the `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. This also stops search from matching the literal text `&bull;`.
  - Audit the owned files for `innerHTML`, `outerHTML` and `insertAdjacentHTML` sinks. There must be none (exit gate 3).
  - Out of scope here: a stricter id pattern in the validator (coresched) and CSP (PGSHELL-45, defence in depth only).
- **Verify:** `components/common/CommandPalette.test.tsx` (jsdom): render the open palette with a task id of `<img src=x onerror="window.__x=1">` and type `img`. Assert that the palette contains no `img` element, that `window.__x` is undefined, and that the subtitle's `textContent` contains the literal id.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-02 · Share-link import replaces local plans matched by name (always on hashchange, name+task-count on load)  `high` `data-loss` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:636-649`; `apps/playground/src/utils.ts:369` (pgstate)
- **Problem:** The hashchange handler takes the name from `?name=` (attacker-controlled) or `meta.title`. It then persists `[shared, ...prev.filter(p => p.name !== sharedName)]`, which silently deletes every local plan or room cache with that name, with no confirm or snapshot. The load path (pgstate) replaces a plan when both the name and the task count match.
- **Fix:**
  - Move the handler into `hooks/useShareLinkImport.ts`. Bind it once and read the latest state through refs, so it stops re-subscribing on every render (its deps today are the per-render `editor`/`project` objects).
  - It calls pgstate's `importSharedPlan(projects, payload, name)`, which dedupes by payload hash, never deletes and adds a `(shared N)` suffix with a 120-character cap. It then calls `addAndOpenProject` (or `activateProject` when an earlier import is reused).
  - Delete the `prev.filter((p) => p.name !== sharedName)` line and the `ACTIVE_JSON` write.
  - Toast `Opened shared plan as "<name>"` with an **Undo** action (PGSHELL-40) that re-activates the previous project.
  - Use pgstate's `generateId("shared")` instead of `Date.now().toString(36)`.
- **Verify:** pgstate's `utils.test.ts` covers `importSharedPlan`. Manual: with a local plan "My Plan", open `?name=My%20Plan#data=<payload>` in the same tab (hashchange). Both plans exist, and opening the identical link again reuses the first import.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-03 · Undo/redo history is global across plans: Ctrl+Z writes plan A into plan B  `high` `data-loss` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:138-142`, `:212-229`; `apps/playground/src/hooks/useUndoRedo.ts:61` (pgstate)
- **Problem:** One `past`/`future` stack lives for the App's whole lifetime, and `clearHistory` is never called. After switching plan or room, Ctrl+Z applies plan A's snapshot to plan B through `handleChartCommit`. It is then autosaved and, in a room, synced to every collaborator.
- **Fix:**
  - Wire pgstate's new signature: `useUndoRedo({ activeProjectId: project.activeProjectId, getCurrent: () => editorRef.current.parsedData, applyData: (d) => editor.handleChartCommit(d, { origin: "undo" }), readOnly: isReadOnly || isPendingLoginEditor, onReadOnly: handlePromptRestrictedAction, showToast })`.
  - Declare it after `roomSync`, because `readOnly` depends on the room role. History resets on `ACTIVE_PROJECT_CHANGED` inside the hook.
  - Remove `undoRedo.pushSnapshot` from `handleGanttCommit`. History is recorded centrally from `LOCAL_COMMIT` (PGSTATE-02).
  - Fallback until pgstate's version lands: `useEffect(() => undoRedo.clearHistory(), [project.activeProjectId, roomSync.activeRoomId])`.
- **Verify:** pgstate's `hooks/useUndoRedo.test.ts` covers the hook. Manual: drag a bar in plan A, switch to plan B, press Ctrl+Z. B is unchanged, also after reload.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-05 · Global single-key shortcuts ignore modifiers, <select> focus and open dialogs  `high` `bug` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:197-272`
- **Problem:** After the Ctrl+K/Z/Y branches, the keys `c b t w ? 1-6` fire with `preventDefault` whatever the state of Ctrl, Meta or Alt. `isInput` omits `SELECT`, `[role=textbox]` and `[role=combobox]`, and nothing checks for an open modal, `e.repeat` or IME composition. As a result Ctrl+C on selected text toggles the critical path and blocks the copy, type-ahead in a `<select>` switches views, and digits typed inside the People or Share dialogs change the view behind them.
- **Fix:**
  - Add `hooks/useGlobalShortcuts.ts`. It exports the `SHORTCUTS` registry and `useGlobalShortcuts(actions)`. `actions` are held in a ref refreshed every render, so the single `keydown` listener is bound exactly once.
  - Guards, in order:
    1. Return if `e.defaultPrevented` or `e.isComposing`.
    2. Ctrl/Cmd+K toggles the palette unless a non-palette `[aria-modal="true"]` is open.
    3. Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Shift+Z and Y run only when the target is not editable.
    4. Single keys require `!e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey` and `!e.repeat`. The target must not be inside `input, textarea, select, [contenteditable], [role=textbox], [role=combobox], [role=listbox]` (checked with `closest`). And `document.querySelector('[aria-modal="true"]')` must return null.
  - Match letters case-insensitively. Shift is allowed only for `?` and `+`.
- **Verify:** `hooks/useGlobalShortcuts.test.ts` dispatches `KeyboardEvent`s:
  - Ctrl+C neither calls `toggleCritical` nor is `defaultPrevented`.
  - `1` with focus in a `<select>` is ignored.
  - `1` while an `[aria-modal=true]` element exists is ignored.
  - Plain `c` toggles the critical path.
  - Ctrl+K toggles the palette.
  - `addEventListener` is called once across 3 re-renders.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-10 · Cloud sync status is computed but never shown; 'Saved' badge reflects only localStorage  `high` `false-logic` `effort M`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/hooks/useRoomSync.ts:91`, `:1031` (roomsync); `apps/playground/src/components/layout/CloudBar.tsx:22` (roomsync); `apps/playground/src/components/layout/Navbar.tsx:119-133`; `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:809-840`
- **Problem:** `syncStatus`/`syncMessage` are computed, including the error and conflict branches at useRoomSync 509, 580, 634 and 638, which raise no toast. CloudBar, their only consumer, is never mounted. In a room the Navbar badge shows the local autosave timer, so users read "Saved" while cloud writes fail, conflict, or are rejected by the rules.
- **Fix:**
  - Status chip on the Cloud button (PGSHELL-09): a dot plus a short label from `roomSync.syncStatus`.
    - `in-sync` / `merged` → "Synced"
    - `syncing` → "Syncing…"
    - `conflict` → amber "Conflict"
    - `error` → red "Sync error"
    - `navigator.onLine === false` → grey "Offline" (from `online`/`offline` listeners, which matters because RTDB queues writes silently)
  - The popover mounts `<CloudBar syncStatus syncMessage isProcessing …/>`. CloudBar is kept: the roomsync contract supersedes the finding's suggestion to delete it.
  - Autosave badge:
    - With `roomSync.activeRoomId` set, the text reads "Saved locally".
    - When `saveStatus === "error"` (pgstate), it reads "Not saved" in red.
    - The label comes from pgstate's `useSaveStatusLabel` inside the leaf components.
  - Announce state changes:
    - A visually hidden `<span role="status" aria-live="polite">` in Navbar announces only transitions into `conflict`/`error` and the recovery back to `in-sync`, with no chatter while syncing.
    - An App effect on `roomSync.syncStatus` raises one sticky error toast per transition into `error`/`conflict`.
- **Verify:**
  - Export a pure `cloudStatusView(status, online)` from Navbar and table-test it in `components/layout/Navbar.test.tsx`.
  - Manual:
    - In a room, DevTools offline → "Offline".
    - Remove your editor role from another session and edit → "Sync error" plus a toast.
    - The local badge reads "Saved locally".

#### [ ] PGSHELL-11 · On phones the fixed bottom nav covers every modal footer and the task-detail sheet  `high` `ux` `effort M`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/index.css:5127` (`.mobile-bottom-nav` z 1200), `:1506` (`.prompt-modal-backdrop` z 1000), `:5293` (sheet 2000), `:5633` (mobile editor 2500), `:5271` (immersive 1500); `packages/core/src/theme.css:2092`, `:2518` (core drawer z 1000, corerender)
- **Problem:** The fixed bottom nav (z 1200) paints above every z-1000 dialog backdrop and above the core task-detail bottom sheet, which is pinned to `bottom:0` on mobile. Save, Confirm and Close sit under the nav on phones. The verifier notes that short centered cards clear it, but tall dialogs and the sheet do not.
- **Fix:**
  - Add the token scale (see Contracts) to `:root`.
  - Assign the tokens:
    - `.navbar`, `.mobile-navbar`, `.mobile-bottom-nav` and the immersive button → `var(--z-chrome)`
    - mobile `.editor-pane` → `var(--z-editor-overlay)`
    - `.prompt-modal-backdrop` and `.mobile-sheet-backdrop` → `var(--z-modal)`
  - Keeping the nav below drawers and modals lets their backdrops cover it. No JS "modal open" flag and no `:has()` selector, which would add subtree style invalidation on every Gantt DOM mutation.
  - Optional ask to corerender: read `var(--jantt-z-drawer, 1000)` in `.jantt-sidebar-backdrop`. Not required for this fix.
- **Verify:** At 375×812, open Add Plan, Share, People, Version history and the task-detail sheet. Every footer button is visible and tappable, and the nav sits under the backdrop. Repeat in immersive landscape (844×390, coarse pointer).

#### [ ] PGSHELL-14 · Universal file import is dead on mobile  `high` `bug` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/components/layout/Navbar.tsx:244-253`; `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:765-806`; `apps/playground/src/components/modals/ModalHost.tsx:224` (pgmodals-a); `apps/playground/src/components/views/ViewRouter.tsx:147` (pgviews)
- **Problem:** The only `<input type=file ref={project.fileInputRef}>` lives inside the desktop Navbar. On mobile and in immersive mode MobileNavbar is rendered instead, so `fileInputRef.current?.click()` does nothing in Add Plan, AutoSave and the Gantt toolbar. MS Project, XER and CSV import are impossible on phones.
- **Fix:**

  - Remove `fileInputRef`/`handleImportJsonFile` from the Navbar props. The `project.fileInputRef.current?.click()` callers in ModalHost and ViewRouter need no change.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-23 · App-level plan switches skip the pending-autosave flush and drop unsaved edits  `high` `data-loss` `effort M`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:402` (fork), `:454` (room select), `:650` (hash import); `apps/playground/src/hooks/useAutoSave.ts:113-153` (pgstate); `apps/playground/src/hooks/useProjectState.ts:96` (pgstate)
- **Problem:** Only `handleSelectProject` flushes. The three App paths call `project.setActiveProjectId` directly, the useAutoSave cleanup then cancels the timer, and its refs move to the new plan. Edits made in the last 5 to 60 s are lost (all of them when autosave is off).
- **Fix:**
  - Route all three paths through pgstate's `project.activateProject` / `addAndOpenProject`. These flush first, then set refs, the URL and the editor, and emit `ACTIVE_PROJECT_CHANGED`. Delete App's four copy-pasted blocks that apply a plan to the editor (fork, room select, hash import and snapshot restore; ARCH-17, App part).
  - `handleForkToLocalCopy` becomes a call to pgstate's `handleForkToLocalPlan(`${activeRoomTitle} (Local Copy)`)` (PGMODALS-46).
  - Bridge until pgstate's helpers land: call `autoSave.flushSave()` before each `setActiveProjectId`.
- **Verify:** Set autosave to 60 s and edit a local plan. Within the 60 s, open a `#data=` link, pick a room in the Plan Manager, or make a local copy. After reload the original plan contains the edit.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-04 · Undo only snapshots Gantt drags; later Kanban/Tasks/Notes/JSON edits are wiped by Ctrl+Z  `medium` `data-loss` `effort M`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:169`, `:683`, `:697`, `:732-755`, `:212-229`; `apps/playground/src/components/views/ViewRouter.tsx:176` (pgviews)
- **Problem:** `pushSnapshot` runs only in `handleGanttCommit`. useTaskActions, usePeopleTeams, useTaskDetailSidebar and the Kanban, Tasks and Notes views commit straight through `editor.handleChartCommit`, which skips both the snapshot and the viewer guard. Ctrl+Z then restores the pre-drag state and discards every later edit, and undo has no read-only gate.
- **Fix:**
  - Rename `handleGanttCommit` to `commitPlan(updated)`; the ViewRouter prop name stays `handleGanttCommit`. It does three things:
    - Gating: pending-login → EditorLogin modal; viewer → fork modal. Drop the duplicate toasts (PGSHELL-12).
    - Commit: `editor.handleChartCommit(updated, { partial: isHideActive || isPersonSorting })`. The manual map-over-master merge is deleted, because pgstate's `partial` mode keeps new ids (today, tasks added while a Hide filter is active are dropped).
    - Undo history comes from `LOCAL_COMMIT`, so every view's edits are recorded.
  - Hand `commitPlan` to useTaskActions, usePeopleTeams and useTaskDetailSidebar through a `commitPlanRef`. These hooks are created before `roomSync`, so they cannot close over `isViewer` directly. The ref also fixes the stale-callback half of PGSTATE-12.
  - Add Undo and Redo icon buttons, bound to `canUndo`/`canRedo`, to Navbar and the mobile sheet (PGSTATE-28).
- **Verify:** Manual:
  - Gantt drag → Kanban status change → note edit → Ctrl+Z reverts only the note edit.
  - A viewer pressing Ctrl+Z gets the fork prompt and the plan is unchanged.
  - With Hide filter on, adding a task from the Gantt keeps the task.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-06 · No React error boundary: any view crash white-screens the app and persists across reloads  `medium` `error-handling` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/main.tsx:6`; `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:922`; `apps/playground/src/components/views/ViewRouter.tsx:79` (pgviews)
- **Problem:** No `getDerivedStateFromError` exists anywhere, so a throwing view blanks the whole UI. The active plan and view are persisted, so a reload can re-render the same data. The verifier rates this as defence in depth, since no concrete crashing input was shown, but PGSTATE-11 found one (`"people": [{}]`).
- **Fix:**
  - `components/common/ErrorBoundary.tsx`, a class component wrapping `<App/>` in `main.tsx` (inside `ModalProvider`, PGSHELL-12). The root fallback offers:
    - Reload.
    - Open built-in template: `ACTIVE_PROJECT_ID = default`, view gantt, then reload.
    - Restore last version, via pgstate's `latestSnapshot`.
    - Download plan JSON.
    - Reset UI state: removes only view, filter and sidebar keys, never project data.
  - The fallback uses plain CSS variables so it still renders when a theme is what crashed. Every storage read sits in try/catch.
  - A `variant="pane"` boundary inside `.chart-container-card` around ViewRouter, with `resetKeys={[activeView, activeProjectId]}` compared in `componentDidUpdate`. The navbar and editor stay usable, and switching plan or view resets it.
  - App registers `unhandledrejection` → one error toast per distinct message.
  - Export the boundary from `components/common/index.ts`. Wiring Jantt's `onError` in ViewRouter belongs to pgviews.
- **Verify:** `components/common/ErrorBoundary.test.tsx`:
  - A throwing child shows the fallback with its actions.
  - Changing `resetKeys` re-renders the children.
  - "Reset UI state" leaves every project key untouched.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-07 · Gantt body has no own stacking context; lasso selection box (z 50) can paint over sticky timeline header  `medium` `ux` `effort S`
- **Where:** `packages/core/src/theme.css:1135`, `:1529`, `:1574`, `:1705`, `packages/core/src/rendering/jantt-engine.ts:432` (corerender); `apps/playground/src/index.css:1484` (`.chart-container-card`), `:2437-2447` (`.jantt-task-dimmed`)
- **Problem:** The Gantt grid container gets only `position:relative`, so body z-indices compete directly with the sticky header (z 40), and `.jantt-selection-box` (z 50) paints over it. The verifier notes that critical bars (14) and paths (10) sit below 40, so the root cause of complaint #1 is not proven and must be reproduced in a browser.
- **Fix (shell part only; the core part belongs to corerender under owner ask #1):**
  - Add `.chart-container-card { isolation: isolate; }`. No chart layer (core uses up to z 100) can then compete with app chrome or the Cloud popover. Core drawers mount on `body` and are unaffected.
  - Scope `.jantt-task-dimmed` under `.chart-container-card` and reduce it to `opacity` only. Drop `filter: grayscale()` and the transition, which are costly to paint on hundreds of SVG groups and grid rows. This is the only `index.css` rule that touches chart internals. It does not raise any layer: verified, no z-index or position.
- **Verify:** Together with corerender's change, in every theme with critical path on and a Dim filter active, scroll both axes at day scale. Nothing paints over the header, and DevTools Layers shows the header above the body.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-15 · Mobile detection heuristic misclassifies desktops and disagrees with CSS breakpoints  `medium` `ux` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/hooks/useMobileDetection.ts:33-39`, `:55-75`; `apps/playground/src/index.css:5598`
- **Problem:** `isMobile = w <= 768 || (h <= 500 && w <= 950)`, and immersive mode is `isMobile && landscape && h < 520` with no pointer check, so a 900×480 desktop window (devtools docked) loses all chrome. Landscape phones between 769 and 950px get the mobile JS chrome with desktop CSS. `setState(getMetrics())` stores a new object every resize frame, although `isTablet`, `viewportWidth` and `viewportHeight` are never read.
- **Fix:**
  - Use `matchMedia` with constants shared with the CSS:
    - `MOBILE_MQ = "(max-width: 768px)"`
    - `COARSE_MQ = "(pointer: coarse)"`
    - `SHORT_LANDSCAPE_MQ = "(orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 520px)"`
  - Derived flags:
    - `isImmersiveLandscape = coarse && shortLandscape`
    - `isMobile = mobile || isImmersiveLandscape`
    - `isPortrait` comes from the orientation query.
  - Subscribe to `change` on the three MediaQueryLists, with no resize/rAF loop. Call `setState` only when one of the three booleans flips.
  - Drop `isTablet`, `viewportWidth` and `viewportHeight` from the type.
  - CSS: widen the mobile block to `@media (max-width: 768px), (pointer: coarse) and (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 520px)`, so JS and CSS agree.
- **Verify:** `hooks/useMobileDetection.test.ts` with a stubbed `matchMedia`:
  - Fine-pointer 900×480 → neither mobile nor immersive.
  - Coarse 844×390 → immersive.
  - A width change within the same class triggers no re-render.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-40 · Toast system: single slot, silent to screen readers, low contrast, no dismiss  `medium` `accessibility` `effort S`

- **Verify:**
  - `hooks/useToast.test.ts` with fake timers: 4 toasts → 3 kept; an error survives 8 s and a success 4 s; a duplicate increments `count`.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-45 · index.html ships no Content-Security-Policy; comment claims a manifest that does not exist  `medium` `security` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/index.html:3-33`; `apps/playground/src/main.tsx`; `apps/playground/public/_headers`
- **Problem:** GitHub Pages cannot send headers and `index.html` has no CSP meta tag, while the app holds Firebase tokens and had an HTML injection sink (PGSHELL-01). The "Favicon & Web Manifest" comment is followed only by a favicon link.
- **Fix:**
  - Install a production-only CSP meta tag first thing in `main.tsx` (`import.meta.env.PROD`). It cannot go in `index.html` because dev relies on the inline React-refresh preamble.
  - Mirror the same policy in `public/_headers` for hosts that honour it, plus `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`. `frame-ancestors` is omitted because embeds are supported.
  - Use an explicit allowlist, not `https:` wildcards. `default-src 'self'`, plus:
    - Scripts and frames:
      - `script-src 'self' https://apis.google.com https://www.gstatic.com https://*.firebaseio.com https://*.firebasedatabase.app` (Auth gapi and the RTDB long-poll JSONP fallback).
      - `frame-src https://<authDomain>` (from `VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN`, default `jantt-cloud.firebaseapp.com`).
    - Connections:
      - `connect-src 'self' https://*.googleapis.com https://*.firebaseio.com wss://*.firebaseio.com https://*.firebasedatabase.app wss://*.firebasedatabase.app https://api.github.com`.
      - `connect-src` does not need `https:`, because linked `?url=` sources are dead (ARCH-33).
    - Assets: `img-src 'self' data: blob: https:`; `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com`; `font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com`; `worker-src 'self' blob:`.
    - Lockdown: `object-src 'none'`; `base-uri 'self'`; `form-action 'self'`.
  - Log `securitypolicyviolation` events with one `console.warn` each.
  - Fix the comment to "Favicon". A web manifest is out of scope (no PWA).
- **Verify:**
  - `npm run build && npm run preview -w @jantt/playground`: GitHub popup sign-in, room join (also with `forceLongPolling()` in a local build), avatars, fonts, exports and the canvas worker all work with zero violations.
  - An `<img src=x onerror=…>` inserted through DevTools is blocked.

#### [ ] PGSHELL-46 · Hash share payloads import silently on every hashchange/popstate with no size limits  `medium` `url-hardening` `effort S`
- **Where:** `apps/playground/src/App.tsx:607-675`; `packages/core/src/share-coder.ts:145` (coresync)

## WS-07 · Playground modals A: plan manager, add plan, modal host, share  (`pgmodals-a`)

- **Goal:** Make managing, creating and sharing plans safe by default. That means exactly three plan lists with one transfer path (a "Move to…" menu plus copy-only drag & drop), one in-app confirmation for every destructive step, and no edit secret in any shared link. All of it is built on one leaf dialog shell that gives every modal the same placement, focus handling, Escape behaviour and stacking.
- **Owned files (exclusive):**
  - `apps/playground/src/components/modals/PlanManagerModal.tsx`
  - `apps/playground/src/components/modals/AddPlanModal.tsx`
  - `apps/playground/src/components/modals/ModalHost.tsx`
  - `apps/playground/src/components/modals/index.ts`
  - `apps/playground/src/components/modals/ShareModal.tsx`
  - New files created by this workstream (no other owner), all under `apps/playground/src/components/modals/`:
    - Leaf modules: `Modal.tsx` (dialog shell), `plan-lists.ts` (pure list and transfer rules), `plan-exports.ts` (export naming and formats).
    - Tests: `plan-lists.test.ts`, `Modal.test.tsx`, `PlanManagerModal.test.tsx`, `AddPlanModal.test.tsx`, `ShareModal.test.tsx`.
- **Contracts (owner notes):**
  - Owner ask #2: PlanManagerModal already has 3 columns (Local / My cloud rooms / Shared with me). It must have exactly those 3 lists, and each card gets a clear "Move to…" dropdown. Move and copy semantics are explicit, and disabled targets explain why. Robust HTML5 drag & drop works between the lists, and the dropdown is the keyboard-accessible alternative. Remove ambiguity: clear labels, and confirmations for destructive actions.
  - Owner ask #4: ModalHost provides consistent placement (centered card, max-height with internal scroll, full-width sheet on mobile), Escape and backdrop close, a focus trap with focus return, scroll lock, and a single shared shell. pgmodals-b must not create a competing modal primitive.
- **Exit criteria:**
  1. `npx tsc -p apps/playground --noEmit` and `npm run build -w @jantt/playground` pass.
  2. `npm test -w @jantt/playground` passes `plan-lists.test.ts`, `Modal.test.tsx`, `PlanManagerModal.test.tsx`, `AddPlanModal.test.tsx` and `ShareModal.test.tsx`.
  3. Grep gate over the owned files and the new leaf modules:
     - no `any`, no `window.confirm` and no `alert(`;
     - no direct `navigator.clipboard` outside the single clipboard helper;
     - `Modal.tsx`, `plan-lists.ts` and `plan-exports.ts` import nothing from `../../firebase` or `../cloud`;
     - after pgmodals-b, roomsync and fbsvc switch their imports, `rg -n "modals/ModalHost|\./ModalHost" apps/playground/src` lists only `App.tsx` and `index.ts`, so there is no import cycle.
  4. Plan manager behaviour:
     - A drop never deletes or leaves a room.
     - Delete plan, Remove from this device, Move to My cloud, Delete room and Leave room each show exactly one in-app `ConfirmDialog` before anything runs.
     - ArrowDown on a card's "Move to…" control never starts a transfer.
  5. Shell behaviour, checked at 375×667, 700×1000, 900×420 (coarse-pointer emulation) and 1280×800:
     - New plan, Share, Plan manager and ConfirmDialog are fully visible, with the body scrolling inside the card.
     - Escape closes only the top dialog, and focus returns to the control that opened it.
  6. Share behaviour: no displayed, copied, WhatsApp, native-share, opened or embedded URL contains `key=` or `edit=`, and the embed snippet is HTML-attribute-escaped.

### Tasks (severity order)

> Line numbers cite the working tree on 2026-11-16. These files are under active in-flight edits, so locate code by symbol. "In flight" means the change is already in the working tree and is reviewed against the task, not rewritten.

#### [ ] PGMODALS-01 · Dragging a cloud room onto the Local column with the default 'Move' mode permanently deletes the room without confirmation  `critical` `data-loss` `effort S`
- **Where:**
  - `PlanManagerModal.tsx`: `getTransferOptions` :225, `getDropTransfer` :258, `dropTargetProps` :747, `executeConfirmed` :594, `describeConfirm` :368.
- **Problem:** At HEAD, `dragMode` defaulted to `'move'`. `handleDropOnLocalColumn` then ran `onDeleteCloudRoom`/`onLeaveCloudRoom` right after `onCreateLocalCopy`, with no confirmation. One accidental drop irreversibly deleted `rooms/<id>` and every member's pointer.
- **Fix:**
  - In flight:
    - The global Move/Copy toggle is gone.
    - `getDropTransfer` returns only copy kinds, and room kinds have no move transfer at all.
    - Delete room and leave room exist only as menu actions behind `ConfirmDialog`. Delete requires typing the room name.
  - Lock the invariant in types: `getDropTransfer(): Exclude<TransferKind, "move_to_cloud"> | null`.
  - In `performTransfer`, room items accept only `copy_to_device` or `copy_to_cloud`.
  - `delete_room` and `leave_room` run only from `executeConfirmed`, through `runExclusive`, using the newest handler (`latestRef.current.onDeleteCloudRoom`).
  - Optional: show the member count in the delete message when the room summary provides it.
- **Verify:**
  - `plan-lists.test.ts`: for every kind × list, `getDropTransfer` never returns `move_to_cloud`, and the options for `owned_room`/`shared_room`/`cached_room` contain no move kind.
  - `PlanManagerModal.test.tsx`: dropping an owned room card on "This device" calls `onCreateLocalCopy` once and never calls `onDeleteCloudRoom` or `onLeaveCloudRoom`.

#### [ ] PGMODALS-02 · Stale closure in handleDeleteCloudRoom/handleLeaveCloudRoom erases the freshly created local copy after a 'move'  `critical` `data-loss` `effort M`
- **Where:**
  - `PlanManagerModal.tsx`: `executeConfirmed` :594.
  - `ModalHost.tsx`: `onDeleteCloudRoom`/`onLeaveCloudRoom` wiring :622.
  - `App.tsx` (pgshell): `dropRoomFromLocalPlans` :617, `handleDeleteCloudRoom` :644, `handleLeaveCloudRoom` :658.
- **Problem:** At HEAD, the drop handler created a local copy and then awaited a delete handler captured before the copy existed. After the network await, it saved a pre-copy project list, so both the room and the new copy vanished. `dropRoomFromLocalPlans` now uses a functional commit but still compares against the captured `project.activeProjectId`.
- **Fix:**
  - This workstream removes the trigger through PGMODALS-01: no modal path chains a room delete or leave after `onCreateLocalCopy`. Copy and delete are separate, explicitly confirmed actions.
  - Room handlers are called through `latestRef.current` after any await.
  - pgshell (PGSHELL-23/PGSTATE-04) reads the active id from a ref inside `dropRoomFromLocalPlans`. This workstream makes no App change.
- **Verify:** Manual: on an owned room, run "Save a copy to this device", then "Delete room for everyone" and confirm. The copy is still listed after a reload, and the open plan is the copy or the template, never a missing entry.

#### [ ] PGMODALS-03 · Local-to-cloud 'move' deletes with a stale handleDeleteProject: drops the new room entry, confirms after publishing, always toasts 'Moved'  `high` `data-loss` `effort M`
- **Where:**
  - `PlanManagerModal.tsx`: `pendingMove` effect :435, `performTransfer` :576/:591, prop doc for `onDeleteProject` :61.
  - `useProjectState.ts` (pgstate): `handleDeleteProject` :415 (still calls `window.confirm` at :424).
- **Problem:**
  - In flight, removal of the device copy is deferred until the new room appears in `customProjects`, which fixes the stale list. Three problems remain:
    - The only confirmation is the hook's `window.confirm`, and it fires after the room already exists. Under PGSTATE-22 (`handleDeleteProject(id): boolean`, never prompts) the move would delete silently.
    - `pendingMove` never expires. A room that shows up much later, for example after reopening it from a link, would still delete the local plan.
    - Nothing reports whether the move completed.
- **Fix:**
  - Add `move_to_cloud` to `ConfirmAction`. Picking it opens `ConfirmDialog` before publishing, with this text: "Move 'X' to My cloud? A new cloud room is created from this plan, and the copy on this device is deleted once the room is saved." Cancel publishes nothing.
  - Type the prop as `onDeleteProject: (id: string) => boolean | void` so it compiles with the old and the new hook.
  - In the effect, compute `const removed = onDeleteProject(localId) !== false`. Then toast `Moved "X" to My cloud.` or `Room created; the copy on this device was kept.`.
  - Store `startedAt` on `pendingMove`. Drop it after 60 s through a `setTimeout` in the effect, with the "kept" toast.
  - Hoist the busy guard into the outer component with `pendingMove` (see PGMODALS-24).
- **Verify:** `PlanManagerModal.test.tsx`:
  - Choosing Move shows the confirm before `onPublishToCloud` is called, and Cancel never calls it.
  - Confirm, then re-render with the room in `customProjects`: `onDeleteProject(localId)` is called exactly once.
  - Without the room, advancing fake timers by 60 s means `onDeleteProject` is never called.

#### [ ] PGMODALS-04 · ShareModal 'Offline Snapshot' link, WhatsApp/native share and public embed snippet leak the room editor secret key  `high` `security` `effort S`
- **Where:**

- **Problem:** `useSharing` appends `#key=<secret>` to the share URL. At HEAD, ShareModal showed that URL as an "offline snapshot", sent it to WhatsApp and native share, and wrapped it in a public `<iframe>` snippet. In flight, `stripShareSecrets` removes `key`/`edit` (including encoded names) from the hash and query of every outbound use. However, `isWhatsAppSafe` is still measured on the unstripped URL, and no test locks this down.
- **Fix:**

- **Verify:** `ShareModal.test.tsx`:
  - `stripShareSecrets` handles `#key=k`, `#data=…&key=k`, `?room=r&key=k#edit=x`, `#%6Bey=k` and `#data=` payloads, keeping the payload byte-for-byte.
  - Render with `shareUrl` containing `#key=abc`. The input value, the copied link and embed (stubbed clipboard), the `window.open` URL (stubbed) and the `navigator.share` args contain no `key=`.

It ignores IME composition and keys whose default was prevented, which inner controls such as rename, search and the menu rely on. It also falls back to a document listener when focus is on `<body>`.

#### [ ] PGMODALS-12 · No dialog semantics, focus trap or focus return in any modal  `high` `accessibility` `effort L`
- **Where:**
  - `ModalHost.tsx`: `Modal` :154-300, `getFocusableElements` :94, `pushModal`/`removeModal` :75-90.
  - `BudgetKpiView.tsx:715` (MonteCarloModal is mounted inside a view).
  - `App.tsx:1121` (theme vars are inline on `.playground-app`).
- **Problem:** In flight, the shell provides `role`/`aria-modal`/`aria-labelledby`, initial focus (`[data-autofocus]`), a Tab trap, focus return and scroll lock. Two gaps remain:
  - Dialogs render in place. A dialog mounted inside a view, or under an animated or transformed ancestor, is positioned against that ancestor rather than the viewport.
  - Focus return uses only the captured opener. When the opener has unmounted (closed menu, removed card), focus drops to `<body>`, and the next Tab leaves the remaining dialog.
- **Fix:**
  - Render the backdrop with `createPortal(content, document.querySelector(".playground-app") ?? undefined)`, and render inline when the root is absent.
    - Do not portal to `document.body`: the theme CSS variables live inline on `.playground-app`, so a portal there would drop them.
    - React 18 still bubbles synthetic events through the React tree, so the shell's `stopPropagation` keeps working.
  - Store `{ id, card }` in `modalStack`. On close, if the opener is gone or not focusable, focus the new top dialog's card (`focus({ preventScroll: true })`).
  - Do not add `inert` on the app shell. `aria-modal` plus the Tab trap meets the WAI-ARIA dialog pattern, and inert would also silence the toast live region rendered in the same tree.
- **Verify:** `Modal.test.tsx` (stub `getClientRects` to return one rect):
  - Open focuses `[data-autofocus]`, Tab and Shift+Tab wrap, and close restores focus to the opener.
  - With a detached opener, focus lands on the remaining top card.
  - `body.style.overflow` is restored only after the last nested dialog closes.
- Manual: the Monte Carlo dialog opened from the Budget view is viewport-centered.

#### [ ] PGMODALS-19 · Plan Manager redesign: exactly 3 lists, dropdown 'Move to' and drag & drop sharing one transfer path  `high` `ux` `effort L`
- **Where:**
  - `PlanManagerModal.tsx`: `buildPlanLists` :127, `getTransferOptions` :225, `dropTargetProps` :747, `renderCard` :781, card `<select>` :908, narrow tabs ~:1205.
- **Problem:**
  - In flight:
    - There are three lists: "This device" (local plans and the built-in sample), "My cloud" (owned rooms) and "Shared with me" (shared rooms and orphaned caches, with a badge).
    - Every transfer is explicitly labelled, and disabled targets carry their reasons.
    - Drag & drop is copy-only, with drop hints. On narrow screens a single list is shown with tabs, and the global toggle is gone.
  - Remaining defect: the keyboard alternative is a native `<select>` that runs the transfer `onChange`. On Windows Chrome and Edge (the owner's platform) and in Firefox, ArrowDown on a closed select fires `change`. Tabbing onto "Move / copy to…" and pressing ArrowDown therefore immediately creates a room or a local copy.
  - Disabled-option reasons are also truncated in a 230px select.
- **Fix:**
  - Replace the `<select>` with a "Move to…" menu button that reuses the card menu machinery: `computeMenuPosition`, `handleMenuKeyDown` and focus return. Make it a small `CardMenu` component local to the file.
    - Group entries by target ("To This device", "To My cloud", "To Shared with me").
    - Give `MenuEntry` `disabled` and `description`. Disabled entries are `aria-disabled="true"`, stay focusable, show their reason as visible secondary text, and cannot be activated.
    - Activation happens only on Enter, Space or click. "Move" entries go through `ConfirmDialog` (PGMODALS-03).
  - Move the pure rules (`buildPlanLists`, `getTransferOptions`, `getDropTransfer`, the types and `PLAN_LIST_ORDER`) into the leaf `plan-lists.ts`. It has no firebase import, so it is testable without SDK init.

PGSTATE-35's registry owns only open flags, not a second stack.

#### [ ] PGMODALS-17 · Modals overflow or get clipped on phones and short viewports  `medium` `ux` `effort M`
- **Where:**
  - `ModalHost.tsx`: `SHEET_MEDIA_QUERY = "(max-width: 640px)"` :55, inline backdrop and card styles in `Modal` ~:250-300.
  - `index.css:5775/5845-5858` (pgshell): `@media (max-width: 768px), (max-height: 500px) and (max-width: 950px) and (pointer: coarse)` with `!important` sheet rules.
- **Problem:** The JS and CSS sheet breakpoints disagree.
  - From 641 to 768px wide, and on coarse-pointer landscape phones up to 950px wide, CSS forces `width: 100vw !important` and sheet corner radii. Meanwhile the inline backdrop keeps `padding: 16px` and `align-items: center`.
  - The card ends up 32px wider than its box, clipped by 16px on each side, with sheet corners floating mid-screen.
  - `height: auto !important` also silently cancels `tall`.
- **Fix:**
  - Export `SHEET_MEDIA_QUERY` with exactly the CSS query, and derive `isSheet` from it, so the inline padding, alignment and radius agree with the `!important` rules.
  - Ask pgshell to reference the constant in a comment next to the index.css query.
  - Document that `tall` applies on desktop only.
  - Keep the PlanManager header actions wrapping (in flight) and the single list with tabs at ≤960px.
- **Verify:** Manual at the four viewports in exit criterion 5, for New plan, Share, Plan manager and ConfirmDialog:
  - no horizontal clipping;
  - header and footer reachable;
  - the body scrolls inside the card;
  - the sheet is bottom-aligned with the safe-area padding.

#### [ ] XSS-22 · Room meta.theme flows unvalidated into share URL and iframe embed attribute  `low` `url-hardening` `effort S`
- **Where:** `ShareModal.tsx`: `embedCode` :200, embed preview ~:660.
- **Problem:** A room editor can set `meta.theme` to a value containing `"`. `useSharing` interpolates it into `shareUrl` without encoding, and ShareModal pastes `shareUrl` raw into `<iframe src="…">`, so a copied snippet can carry attribute or HTML injection into a wiki.

  - Use this snippet: `` `<iframe src="${esc(safeUrl)}" title="${esc(`Jantt plan: ${currentProjectName}`)}" width="100%" height="600" style="border:0" loading="lazy" allowfullscreen></iframe>` ``. This also drops the obsolete `frameborder`.
  - The `<code>` preview is React text, so it is already safe.
  - Roomsync validates `meta.theme` against `themeManager.getTheme` and builds URLs with `URLSearchParams`.
- **Verify:** `ShareModal.test.tsx`: with a `shareUrl` containing `"` and `<`, the copied snippet parsed by `DOMParser` yields exactly one `iframe`, whose `src` equals `safeUrl` and which has no extra attributes.
